description: Lists the CAA (Certification Authority Authorization) records published on a domain: which CAs may issue certificates (issue), wildcard certificates (issuewild) and the incident-report address (iodef). Shows the records on the exact name only; CAA is inherited from parent domains when a name has none, which this tool does not walk. Choose this tool for: Lists the CAA records published on a domain: which CAs may. Close alternatives on this server: security_dmarc_spf_dkim (Email authentication DNS records for a domain: DMARC); security_dns_records (DNS records of a domain resolved live through the public). Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
